profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer / Tech Lead
profile.summary:
Senior Java Software Engineer with extensive experience designing, developing, and implementing complex cloud native, enterprise-grade applications.

Proven ability to architect and deliver microservices, build robust web applications, and establish seamless system-to-system integrations.

Experience managing offshore team and fostering collaboration among diverse stakeholders.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer / Tech Lead
positions.description:
• Built the FinTech, cloud native application, that integrates lenders with SAP customers seeking financing (Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Redis, Postgresql, Cloud Foundry, Elasticsearch, Dynatrace)
• Refactored and extended the initial POC into a fully functioning financial microservice application utilizing services within the SAP BTP Cloud Platform.
• Led the migration of a monolithic legacy application component to a new microservice for prospective new vendors wishing to join the SAP Business Network.
• Created workflows that screen and qualify vendors using Temporal.io framework.
• Built REST APIs for UI and data extraction, enabling system to system communication.
• Collaborate with PM, PO, Architect, IT Security/Privacy, and QA teams to determine impact analysis, create feature estimations, technical design, assist with user story creation, implementation planning and resource allocation.
• Drove the security validation process, implementing targeted remediation strategies to address security risks and elevate the application to a 5-star security rating for 2 consecutive years.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Microservices · Cloud Applications · Redis · Temporal · Apache Kafka · PostgreSQL · Elasticsearch · REST APIs · OData · Back-End Web Development · Technical Leadership · Swagger API

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed new features for a cloud-native workforce planning/forecasting tool using Java, Spring boot, JPA, Hibernate, Cucumber, Rest Assured, Mockito.
• Built new REST APIs to extract information from on-prem systems to cloud solution.
• Implemented a CSRF protection mechanism for web apps (Synchronizer Token Pattern).
- Created a testing framework with REST Assured for APIs integration testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Cloud Applications · Back-End Web Development · Software Design · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Designer V
positions.description:
• Developed software components for a Java web and a distributed multi-threading application in charge of collecting social media data & news. (Java, J2EE, Spring, RabbitMQ, Hibernate, EXT-JS, JavaScript).
• Implemented Twitter API (GNIP - PowerTrack) to ingest tweets based on configurable customer rules, enabling near real-time social media monitoring.
• Built REST services and software components for an enterprise multi-channel customer analysis application (C#, EXT-JS, JavaScript, NHibernate, MSSQL)
• Implementation and integration of the Twitter REST API 1.0 & 1.1 for user engagement.
• Gap analysis evaluation between HP IDOL and Apache Solr
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · Back-End Web Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Technical Leadership · JSON

positions.title: Software Designer
positions.description:
•	Execute impact analysis and technical design for new features for a Point of Sale application based on the high level design docs.(J2EE, Struts, JSP, Oracle, Web Services)
•	Coordinate and supervise the development effort with offshore resources.
•	Creation of web services simulations with SOAP UI eliminating development roadblocks.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Cost and effort estimation, impact analysis and development coordinator for an electronic invoice application (Spring, Hibernate, MySQL, MSSQL, Apache, Tomcat, XML).
• Web Services design and implementation using Apache Axis.
• Technical design and prototype development for new features.
• Software Release Coordinator for 3 products.
• Support QA phase by tracking and assigning defects to development team.

certifications.name: Parallel and Concurrent Programming with Java 1
certifications.title: Parallel and Concurrent Programming with Java 1

patents.title: Automated scheduling assistant for a workforce management system
patents.description: A system and methods are provided for a workforce management (WFM) system adapted to perform automated scheduling operations based on scheduling rule(s) and/or parameter(s). The system includes a processor and a computer readable medium operably coupled thereto, to perform the scheduling operations which include automatically generating a survey comprising queries based on the scheduling rule(s) and parameter(s) having at least a first and second dimension, distributing the survey to user(s) via one or more interfaces of the WFM system, detecting each response to the survey via the WFM system, analyzing, using a deep learning model, each survey response, generating one or more recommendations for the user(s) based on analyzing each response using the deep learning model, detecting one or more feedbacks to the survey via the WFM system, and adjusting, using the deep learning model and the feedback(s) to the recommendation(s), one or more of the parameters for the survey.
